description_expanded: OverviewLuxury Gulf View Town Home with Easy Beach Access - 'BeeBy The Sea'The Space BeeBy the Sea – Luxury Gulf-View Retreat in Inlet Beach! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: 2 King Master Suites – Both with full ensuite bathrooms for ultimate comfort 3-Minute Walk to Inlet Beach – Easy access to pristine sands & Camp Helen State Park 2 Private Balconies with Gulf Views – Stunning sunsets & ocean breezes Sunbathing Space on Master Balcony – Relax in private lounge chairs with panoramic views Outdoor Dining on Balcony – Enjoy alfresco meals with breathtaking Gulf scenery Fully Equipped Kitchen – Featuring quartz countertops & stainless steel appliances 2 Beach Bike Cruisers Included – Explore 30A’s trails & scenic coastal areas Accommodates 2 Vehicles – Private driveway & carport for easy parking High-Speed Wi-Fi & Cable on All TVs – Stay connected & entertained Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a seamless vacationWelcome to BeeBy The SeaDiscover a quintessential luxury retreat on 30A's prestigious shoreline with 30A Vacay.BeeBy the Sea offers an unforgettable experience just one tier back from the oceanfront, providing stunning gulf views and convenient beach access. Located near Rosemary Beach, this luxury vacation home is surrounded by pristine sand dunes, a secluded beach, and Camp Helen State Park, offering a perfect blend of tranquility and adventure for your next 30A Vacay getaway.First Floor: Step into a fully equipped kitchen featuring elegant white quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and dining space for 4. The kitchen flows seamlessly into a half bath, a cozy living area, and a balcony. Outdoors, savor alfresco dining, complete with breathtaking gulf views of the pristine shores of 30A. The open-concept layout of the kitchen, living area, and balcony creates an inviting space perfect for both entertaining and unwinding after a day at the beach. Living room also features a sleeper sofa.Second Floor: The master bedroom features a private balcony furnished with 2 lounge chairs, ideal for sunbathing while soaking in panoramic gulf views. Adjacent is the second master bedroom suite, both boasting king-size beds with luxurious linens, full ensuite bathrooms, spa-quality towels, and sustainably sourced bathroom amenities. For added convenience, find a laundry closet in the hallway equipped with a washer, dryer, iron, ironing board, and steamer.Ground Level: On the ground level, you'll find a carport with space for two vehicles, along with 2 adult bikes perfect for exploring the area, and a grill for enjoying outdoor meals.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**Construction Update:Construction activities are currently underway in the vicinity of our property, including areas between the home and the ocean, and within the surrounding community. Please note the following details:The construction involves three full-lot homes on the first row of our community. At the beginning of the year, we discounted our rates due to these ongoing developments.Despite the construction, your unit will maintain a picturesque gulf view directly in front, as well as an eastern view overlooking Camp Helen State Park. No construction is planned directly in front of your unit.As construction varies day-to-day, we cannot predict the exact noise levels during your stay. Please be aware that some noise may occur periodically.Our property is situated in a dynamic, growing community with ongoing construction of luxury homes nearby.We are more than happy to discuss any concerns you may have regarding the construction in the area. Feel free to contact us by phone for further information before making your reservation. Thank you for considering our property. We look forward to accommodating you.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (6)2nd Floor: Master Bedroom - King sized bed, ensuite bath, walk in shower2nd Floor: Master Bedroom - King sized bed, ensuite bath, shower-tub comboSleeper sofa in living roomShow less
